eligibility_criteria: 1. Candidates must have passed the 12th Standard (10+2) examination with Science subjects, securing a minimum of 60% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB). A pass in English is also required.2. The minimum age for admission is 17 years and the maximum age is 35 years, as of 31st December of the year of admission.
about_program: A 4-year undergraduate nursing programme at SRM Institute of Science and Technology focused on clinical foundations, patient care skills and professional nursing practice.
career_opportunities: Nursing Practice, Clinical Care, Hospital & Community Health
